name: jdbc-truststore-init
command: set -eu; mkdir -p "$JDBC_TLS_SSL_PATH" "$JDBC_TLS_SSL_PATH/split"; rm -f "$JDBC_TLS_SSL_PATH/source.pem" "$JDBC_TLS_SSL_PATH/.masking_certs"; rm -f "$JDBC_TLS_SSL_PATH/split/"*.crt; if [ -n "$JDBC_TLS_CERT_SOURCE_S3_URI" ]; then aws s3 cp "$JDBC_TLS_CERT_SOURCE_S3_URI" "$JDBC_TLS_SSL_PATH/source.pem"; elif [ -n "$JDBC_TLS_CERT_SOURCE_SECRET_ARN" ]; then aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$JDBC_TLS_CERT_SOURCE_SECRET_ARN" --query SecretString --output text > "$JDBC_TLS_SSL_PATH/source.pem"; else echo "No JDBC TLS certificate source configured"; exit 1; fi; awk -v outdir="$JDBC_TLS_SSL_PATH/split" 'BEGIN{n=0} /BEGIN CERTIFICATE/{n++; f=sprintf("%s/cert-%02d.crt", outdir, n)} {if(n>0) print > f} /END CERTIFICATE/{close(f)}' "$JDBC_TLS_SSL_PATH/source.pem"; certs="$(find "$JDBC_TLS_SSL_PATH/split" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.crt' | sort)"; [ -n "$certs" ] || { echo 'No certificates extracted from certificate source'; exit 1; }; for f in $certs; do a="$(basename "$f" .crt)"; keytool -import -trustcacerts -keystore "$JDBC_TLS_SSL_PATH/.masking_certs" -storepass "$JDBC_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD" -noprompt -alias "$a" -file "$f"; done; keytool -list -keystore "$JDBC_TLS_SSL_PATH/.masking_certs" -storepass "$JDBC_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD"
